title: Uniqueness of pressureless flow
summary: We consider the pressureless Euler equations in one spatial dimension. These equations model the dynamics of particles on a line that interact only through perfectly inelastic collisions. The flow was first shown to be unique for given initial conditions by Huang and Wang, assuming the entropy and the strong initial continuity of energy conditions hold. In this paper, we prove an analogous uniqueness theorem using a Lagrangian interpretation.
